verdict.rationale: Supabase is built on standard Postgres. It documents direct Postgres connections, so standard tooling can reach the data, and it can be self-hosted via Docker Compose, which gives an exit path off the hosted platform. Its daily backups are produced with pg_dump, an open dump format, per a community report. However, nothing in the evidence documents an explicit export-and-leave workflow; the migration docs only cover moving into Supabase. Missing for 10: documented export/off-boarding guide, evidence of exporting Storage files and Auth users in open formats, independent corroboration of a successful full exit.
